Fixed by classifying only definite connection absence, checking both endpoints, retaining endpoints, and still refusing unsafe ownership/symlinks, permission errors, timeouts or a partially live host.
findings.F2: Confirmed via real installed CLI and host with same package version but different hashes. System curl uses the unchanged official release URL through a task-local TLS CONNECT metadata fixture; no product source override or application credentials. Reviewed head returned zero without changing host; fixed head activates the installed image even when no files download. findings.F3: Confirmed. File-change preflight now runs only after release/version decisions and before mutation. Already-active image observation does not demand transfer readiness; actual installation preflight remains strict. Unit sequencing test plus active canonical execution and real CLI no-op coverage.
findings.F4: Confirmed. Successful headless upgrade now reports previous_frontend_count=0, client_recovery=no_previous_clients and separate fresh_controller_verified evidence, not invented frontend negotiation.
findings.F5: Confirmed, not merely hypothetical: task-private dyld constructor stops before Rust main, then the executable pathname is atomically replaced. Reviewed head serves with replacement hash although its loaded image is the old binary. Fixed identity opens one descriptor, verifies its device/inode against the kernel vnode for dyld's loaded main image via libproc (Linux uses /proc/self/exe), hashes that same descriptor and checks metadata stability. A byte-identical same-UUID copy is deliberately rejected as a different executing vnode; the constructor fixture compiles official SDK size/offset assertions for the narrow libproc ABI. A mismatched startup fails before listener/domain effects. No production test hook or new dependency. This is image/path coherence within the existing local trust model, not a same-UID malicious-code sandbox or full memory attestation.
findings.F6: Coverage gap accepted and filled by native socket tests, no-op/preflight tests and a real native update/identity matrix in the manual full workflow. Temporal correction: the previous head's full run 43940978118 has since completed successfully; its actual installer step ran and its retained macos-intel native-upgrade packet passed. The daily skipped step did not mean no full execution. That historical full success does not replace full checks or independent QA for the new head.
